heading: Descriptive statistics
text:
### Descriptive statistics [LSER.16.2]

| Function | Meaning | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `mean(cursor)` | arithmetic mean | `Float?` |
| `median(cursor)` | 50th percentile | `Float?` |
| `min(cursor)` | minimum value | slot type, nullable |
| `max(cursor)` | maximum value | slot type, nullable |
| `sum(cursor)` | sum | slot type |
| `count(cursor)` | sample count | `Int` |

A nullable return is `null` exactly when the read is cold ([LSER.19.8]).
